aj2457.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: جبريل, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
أرجع حفصة، فإنها صوامة قوامة، وإنها زوجتك في الجنة.
Take Ḥafṣah back. She fasts frequently and often stands in prayer, and she is your wife in Paradise. Ibn Ḥajar notes this report is mursal.
نافع, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما ماتت حفصة حتى ما تفطر.
Toward the end of her life, Ḥafṣah was fasting continually.
جبرائيل عليه السلام, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
راجع حفصة، فإنها قوامة صوامة، وإنها زوجتك في الجنة.
Take Ḥafṣah back. She often stands in prayer and fasts, and she is your wife in Paradise.
إنها صوامة قوامة، وإنها زوجتك في الجنة
She fasts frequently and often stands in prayer, and she is your wife in Paradise.
أرجع حفصة فإنها صوامة قوامة وهي زوجتك في الجنة
Take Ḥafṣah back. She fasts frequently and stands often in prayer, and she is your wife in Paradise.
فإنها صؤوم قؤوم وإنها من نسائك في الجنة.
She fasts frequently and stands often in prayer, and she is one of your wives in Paradise.
ما ماتت حفصة حتى ما تفطر.
Toward the end of her life, Ḥafṣah was fasting continually.

aj8213.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
سئ الحفظ، وهو دون حيوة وسعيد بن أبي أيوب في الحديث
Poor memory; he is below Ḥaywah and Saʿīd ibn Abī Ayyūb in hadith.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
يحيى بن أيوب أحب إلي، ومحل يحيى الصدق، يكتب حديثه ولا يحتج به
Abū Ḥātim: I prefer Yaḥyā (to Ibn Abī al-Mawāl); his standing is truthfulness; his hadith is written but not used as proof.
ليس بالقوي. وقال في موضع آخر: ليس به بأس
Not strong; elsewhere: there is no harm in him.
كان أحد الطلابين للعلم، حدث عن أهل مكة والمدينة والشام وأهل مصر والعراق، وحدث عنه الغرباء بأحاديث ليست عند أهل مصر عنه
He was an active seeker of learning. He narrated from people in Mecca, Medina, Syria, Egypt and Iraq. Outsiders narrated reports from him that Egyptians did not have from him.
وأحاديث جرير بن حازم، عن يحيى بن أيوب، ليس عند المصريين منها حديث، وهي تشبه عندي أن تكون من حديث ابن لهيعة
Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim's hadiths from him are unknown to the Egyptians and seem to me to be Ibn Lahīʿah's hadith.
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among the reliable narrators.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
There is no harm in him, according to another statement.

t4791.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq al-Ṭanāfusī as trustworthy and devout, of the tenth generation, who died in year 3 or 35.
as: Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان ثقة صدوقا، وهو أحب إلي من أبي بكر بن أبي شيبة في الفضل والصلاح، وأبو بكر أكثر حديثا منه وأفهم.
He was trustworthy and truthful. I prefer him to Abū Bakr ibn Abī Shaybah for virtue and uprightness, but Abū Bakr knew more hadiths and had a better understanding.
أبو يعلى الخليل القزويني, quoted by al-Mizzī
ولهما محل عظيم، ولم يكن إسنادهما في ذلك الوقت بعال
The two brothers held a high standing, though their chains were not especially short for the time.
